concepts.title: 对数基础与选择题
concepts.summary: $\log_bx=y\Leftrightarrow b^y=x$，$b>0,b\ne1,x>0$。反函数图关于 $y=x$ 对称。

method.title: 检查
method.body: 把选项转回指数式或核对图像域、渐近线与单调性。

en.title: Logarithm fundamentals and multiple choice
en.summary: $\log_bx=y\Leftrightarrow b^y=x$, with $b>0,b\ne1,x>0$. Inverse graphs reflect in $y=x$.

method.title: Check
method.body: Convert choices back to exponential form or check a graph’s domain, asymptote and monotonicity.

concepts.title: 变换与图像特征
concepts.summary: 用 $b(x-h)>0$ 求域，用 $x=h$ 求垂直渐近线；令 $x=0$ 或 $y=0$ 求截距并核对域。

en.title: Transformations and graph characteristics
en.summary: Use $b(x-h)>0$ for the domain and $x=h$ for the vertical asymptote. Set $x=0$ or $y=0$ for intercepts and check the domain.

concepts.title: 对数与指数方程
concepts.summary: 对数方程保留所有原真数的正限制；候选值必须代回。指数方程取对数后保留精确式到最后舍入。

method.title: 求解
method.body: 合并对数并指数化，或对指数两边取对数；验证全部候选。

en.title: Logarithmic and exponential equations
en.summary: Keep positivity restrictions for every original log argument and substitute candidates back. For exponential equations, retain exact log expressions until rounding.

method.title: Solve
method.body: Combine and exponentiate logs, or take logs of exponential sides; verify all candidates.

concepts.title: 应用与解释
concepts.summary: 先统一单位和每期利率；科学尺度的对数差表示倍数。增长与衰减周期保持正值，实际支付按完整期数判断。

method.title: 建模
method.body: 写出比值或现金流方程，再求未知时间、周期或比例。

en.title: Applications and interpretation
en.summary: Align units and periodic rates. Log differences on scientific scales represent ratios. Growth and decay periods are positive, and actual payments require whole-period interpretation.

method.title: Model
method.body: Write a ratio or cash-flow equation, then solve for time, period or ratio.

exercises.prompt: 选择 $y=(1/4)^x$ 的逆函数图：A、B、C、D见原图。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: D符合这些特征；A、B是指数形，C是递增对数形。

en.prompt: Which graph represents the inverse of $y=(1/4)^x$? Choose A, B, C or D from the given graphs.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Swapping $x,y$ gives $x=(1/4)^y$, so $y=\log_{1/4}x$. It is defined for $x>0$, decreases, passes through $(1,0),(1/4,1),(4,-1)$ and has asymptote $x=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: D has these features. A and B are exponential-shaped curves, while C is an increasing log curve.

en.prompt: The exponential form of $k=-\log_h5$ is: A $h^k=1/5$; B $h^k=-5$; C $k^h=1/5$; D $k^h=-5$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $-k=\log_h5$ means $h^{-k}=5$. Taking reciprocals gives $h^k=1/5$, with $h>0,h\ne1$.

exercises.prompt: $y=\log_3x$ 变成 $y=\log_3\sqrt{x+7}$。选择：A 竖直因子1/2、上移7；B 竖直因子1/2、左移7；C 水平因子1/2、上移7；D 水平因子1/2、左移7。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 对数真数要求 $\sqrt{x+7}>0$，即 $x>-7$。幂法则给 $y=\frac12\log_3(x+7)$，所以竖直缩为1/2、左移7。

en.prompt: $y=\log_3x$ is transformed to $y=\log_3\sqrt{x+7}$. Choose: A vertical factor 1/2 and up 7; B vertical factor 1/2 and left 7; C horizontal factor 1/2 and up 7; D horizontal factor 1/2 and left 7.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: The log requires $\sqrt{x+7}>0$, hence $x>-7$. The power law gives $y=\frac12\log_3(x+7)$: vertical factor 1/2 and left 7.

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 在 $x>0$ 的通常实幂域上，$x^p/x^q=x^{p-q}$，再用幂法则得 $(p-q)\log_3x$。

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: On the usual real-power domain $x>0$, $x^p/x^q=x^{p-q}$. The power law gives $(p-q)\log_3x$.

exercises.prompt: $pH=-\log[H^+]$（mol/L）。乙酸pH2.9，甲酸浓度为其4倍。甲酸pH为：A1.1；B2.3；C3.5；D6.9。

en.prompt: $pH=-\log[H^+]$, with concentration in mol/L. Acetic acid has pH 2.9; formic acid is four times as concentrated. Its pH is A1.1, B2.3, C3.5 or D6.9.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $[H^+]_f=4\cdot10^{-2.9}$, so $pH_f=2.9-\log4\approx2.29794$, rounding to 2.3.

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (c) 外层对数给 $\log_x125=3$；$x^3=125$，$x=5$。底数5合法，内层值3为正。(d) 逆性质给 $x=3$。

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) The outer log gives $\log_x125=3$, so $x^3=125$ and $x=5$. Base 5 is valid and the inner value 3 is positive. (d) The inverse property gives $x=3$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (e) $8^{x-3}>0$ for all real $x$. The left side is $3(x-3)=4$, so $x=13/3$, giving original argument 16.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $125=5^3$, so $m+n=3$. The second requires $m-n>0,m-n\ne1$ and gives $(m-n)^3=8$, hence $m-n=2$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Adding gives $m=5/2$, then $n=1/2$. Base 2 is valid and $\log_2 8=3$.

exercises.prompt: 描述从 $y=\log_2x$ 到 $y=-5\log_2(8(x-1))$ 的一系列变换。还能用什么另一组变换？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 直接点映射为 $(u,v)\mapsto(u/8+1,-5v)$：水平缩为1/8、竖直伸为5倍并关于 $x$轴反射、最后右移1。域 $x>1$，渐近线 $x=1$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 另一法：$-5\log_2(8(x-1))=-5\log_2(x-1)-15$。先竖直伸5倍并 $x$轴反射，再右移1、下移15。两式在 $x>1$ 完全相同。

exercises.answer: 两组有效变换如上；共同域 $x>1$。

en.prompt: Describe transformations from $y=\log_2x$ to $y=-5\log_2(8(x-1))$. What other series could be used?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: The direct mapping is $(u,v)\mapsto(u/8+1,-5v)$: horizontal factor 1/8, vertical factor 5 with reflection in the $x$-axis, then right 1. Domain $x>1$, asymptote $x=1$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Alternatively, $-5\log_2(8(x-1))=-5\log_2(x-1)-15$. Vertically scale by 5 and reflect in the $x$-axis, then translate right 1 and down 15. The formulas agree for $x>1$.

en.answer: Two valid series are given above; both have domain $x>1$.

exercises.prompt: 对 $y=2\log_5(x+5)+6$ 求：(a)渐近线；(b)定义域和值域；(c)$y$截距；(d)$x$截距。

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $x+5=0$ gives $x=-5$. (b) Positivity gives domain $x>-5$; range is $\mathbb R$. (c) At $x=0$, $y=2\log_5 5+6=8$, so $(0,8)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (d) Set $y=0$: $x+5=5^{-3}=1/125$, hence $x=-624/125$, inside the domain.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Domain $x>4$. $(x-4)/(x+2)=16$ gives $x=-12/5$, outside the domain; no solution.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Domain $x>4$. $(x-4)(x+2)=16$ gives $(x-6)(x+4)=0$; retain 6, whose argument product is $2\cdot8=16$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) Positivity of the seventh power requires $x^2-2x>0$, hence $x<0$ or $x>2$. From $(x^2-2x)^7=2^{21}$ obtain $x^2-2x=8$, giving $(x-4)(x+2)=0$. Both −2 and 4 produce original argument $8^7=2^{21}$.

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) $(x-2)\log12=(2x+1)\log3$，$x(\log12-2\log3)=2\log12+\log3$，所以 $x=(2\log12+\log3)/(\log12-2\log3)\approx21.09$。分母 $\log(4/3)>0$，精确值可验等式。

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $(2x+1)\log3=\log75$ gives $x=(\log75/\log3-1)/2\approx1.46$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) $(x-2)\log12=(2x+1)\log3$ gives $x(\log12-2\log3)=2\log12+\log3$, so $x=(2\log12+\log3)/(\log12-2\log3)\approx21.09$. The denominator $\log(4/3)>0$; the exact value verifies the equation.

exercises.prompt: Holly将中奖1 000 000元全投年金，年利率6%，半年复利。每半年末取35 000元，能取多少年？用 $PV=R[1-(1+i)^{-n}]/i$，$n$为等额付款数、$i$每期利率。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: $n=\log7/\log1.03\approx65.8318$ 次，即模型约32.9159年。实际可足额取65次，最后足额付款在32.5年；第66次（33年）只能取余款。不能把65.8318向上取整为66次完整35 000元。

exercises.answer: 65次完整提款，持续至32.5年；模型耗尽时间约32.92年，第33年末仅余款。

en.prompt: Holly invests a 1 000 000 dollars lottery win in an annuity at 6% annually, compounded semi-annually. She withdraws 35 000 dollars at each six-month end. For how many years can she make withdrawals? Use $PV=R[1-(1+i)^{-n}]/i$, with $n$ equal payments and periodic rate $i$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $n=\log7/\log1.03\approx65.8318$ payments, or 32.9159 model years. In practice, 65 full withdrawals are possible, the last at 32.5 years; only a partial balance is available at payment 66, year 33. Rounding up would incorrectly promise 66 full 35 000 dollars payments.

en.answer: 65 full withdrawals through 32.5 years; model duration about 32.92 years, with only a partial final withdrawal at year 33.

exercises.prompt: 跨细胞壁运输1 mol物质的自由能变化 $\Delta G=1427.6(\log C_2-\log C_1)$ Cal，$C_1$细胞内浓度、$C_2$细胞外浓度。若葡萄糖 $\Delta G=4200$ Cal，外浓度是内浓度多少倍？

en.prompt: The free-energy change to transport one mole across a cell wall is $\Delta G=1427.6(\log C_2-\log C_1)$ Cal, where $C_1$ is inside and $C_2$ outside concentration. If glucose transport has $\Delta G=4200$ Cal, how many times as great is the outside concentration?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $C_1,C_2>0$. $\log(C_2/C_1)=4200/1427.6\approx2.94200$, hence $C_2/C_1=10^{4200/1427.6}\approx874.985$. The positive energy difference corresponds to greater outside concentration.

exercises.prompt: 声级 $\beta=10\log(I/I_0)$ dB，$I_0=10^{-12}$ W/m²。餐厅冰箱45 dB，老板拟再放一台相同冰箱并排运行，担心太吵。应担心吗？说明。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 一台声强 $I=I_0 10^{4.5}$。按两台独立声源的声强相加，合声强为 $2I$，声级 $10\log(2I/I_0)=45+10\log2\approx48.01$ dB。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 只增加约3.01 dB，并非90 dB。“太吵”没有给定判据，故不能从数据断定舒适度；可说明数值增幅有限，是否可接受需与餐厅的噪声要求比较。

exercises.answer: 合计约48.0 dB，增加3.0 dB；是否太吵需给定标准。

en.prompt: Sound level is $\beta=10\log(I/I_0)$ dB, with $I_0=10^{-12}$ W/m². A restaurant refrigerator is 45 dB. The owner wants a second identical refrigerator side by side and worries the combined noise will be too loud. Should she be concerned? Justify.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: One unit has intensity $I=I_0 10^{4.5}$. Adding intensities for two independent sources gives $2I$, hence combined level $45+10\log2\approx48.01$ dB.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: The increase is about 3.01 dB, not a doubling of the decibel number. No criterion for “too loud” is specified, so comfort cannot be decided from the data alone; compare the calculated level with the restaurant’s noise requirements.

en.answer: About 48.0 dB combined, a 3.0 dB increase; whether that is too loud needs a stated criterion.

exercises.prompt: 乙醇生物反应器酵母初始4.0 g/L，8 h后12.8 g/L。求倍增时间至0.1 h。

en.prompt: A yeast culture in an ethanol bioreactor starts at 4.0 g/L and reaches 12.8 g/L after 8 h. Find its doubling time to the nearest tenth of an hour.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Let doubling time $d>0$. $12.8=4.0\cdot2^{8/d}$ gives $3.2=2^{8/d}$, so $d=8\log2/\log3.2\approx4.7674$ h, rounding to 4.8 h. The unrounded value reproduces 12.8 g/L.

exercises.prompt: CPI以1992年固定商品篮价格为100%，2006年为129.9%。若保持相同增长率，哪一年价格成为1992年的两倍？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: $200=100a^t$，$t=\log2/\log a=14\log2/\log1.299\approx37.0958$ 年。连续模型日期 $1992+t\approx2029.10$，在2029年内；若仅比较年度同一日期的CPI，则第一次不低于200%是在2030年（38个完整年）。

exercises.answer: 连续指数模型约在2029年；按整年观测首次达标为2030年。

en.prompt: The CPI compares a fixed basket with its 1992 price, set at 100%. In 2006 the price was 129.9%. If it keeps growing at the same rate, in what year will the basket cost twice its 1992 price?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Let $t$ be years after 1992 and $C(t)=100a^t$. Since $a^{14}=1.299$, $a=1.299^{1/14}\approx1.01886$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $200=100a^t$ gives $t=14\log2/\log1.299\approx37.0958$ years. The continuous model reaches double at $1992+t\approx2029.10$, during 2029. If comparing only annual observations at the same date, the first at least 200% is 2030, after 38 whole years.

en.answer: Continuous exponential model: during 2029; first whole-year observation at least double: 2030.
